summary: Craig defended causal necessity, finite-past paradoxes, and personal agency; Malpass more successfully exposed categorical causal gaps, coherent infinities, and underdetermined creator attributes.

pro.text: I think the appropriate category would be a personal explanation
pro.context: Craig selects personal agency as the appropriate explanation for a nonphysical initial state and the universe’s finite temporal origin.

con.text: the indeterministic causation option looks basically just the same except without the personal aspect to it
con.context: Malpass argues that impersonal indeterministic causation can supply the timing flexibility attributed to libertarian choice without implying personhood.
